description: This file provides utilities for enumerating audio input devices (microphones) across different platforms using FFmpeg. It includes functions to locate FFmpeg, cache its path, and list devices on macOS (AVFoundation), Linux (PulseAudio), and Windows (DirectShow).

methods.name: findFFmpeg
methods.description: Locates the FFmpeg executable, using platform-specific fallback paths if necessary, and caches the result.

methods.name: listMicrophoneDevices
methods.description: Lists available microphone devices using FFmpeg, depending on the platform.
